subject: financial_literacy
concept: Reading a simple bank statement or account balance and understanding deposits and withdrawals
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student records simple deposit and withdrawal entries on a simplified physical account register
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described transaction to whether it's a deposit or a withdrawal
exercise.abstract: Student calculates a new balance after a described deposit or withdrawal

misconception_flags: adds a withdrawal to the balance instead of subtracting it, or vice versa

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
